title: Police detain protesters outside Thirupparankundram temple

ai.summary: Police detained protesters outside Thirupparankundram temple who were blocking the girivalam pathway and resisting arrest, following demonstrations over the non-lighting of the lamp at the 'dheepathoon'.

facts.claim: Police detained protesters outside Thirupparankundram temple
facts.quote: Police personnel deployed for security at the Thirupparankundram foothills detained many protesters who gathered to stage a demonstration outside the Sri Subramaniaswamy Temple.
Although devotees were permitted to use the girivalam pathway, their movement was initially obstructed by demonstrators blocking the route.

facts.claim: Protesters resisted arrest and attempted to damage public property
facts.quote: The demonstrators, mostly affiliated to BJP and other Hindu outfits, resisted arrest and attempted to damage public property, prompting police to forcefully detain and remove them from the site.

facts.claim: Police took away a family protesting over non-lighting of the lamp
facts.quote: In a separate incident, police also took away a family of three — a husband, wife, and child — who were staging a protest over the non-lighting of the lamp at the ‘dheepathoon.’

ai.background_note: The Thirupparankundram protests involve Hindu Munnani demanding Tamil Nadu government comply with Madras High Court orders on lighting the Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankundram Hill.
